@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from .core import Group
+
+F = t.TypeVar("F", bound="t.Callable[..., t.Any]")
+
+
+class ReplaceResultDefault(Group):
+    """A :class:`~click.Group` whose :meth:`result_callback` replaces an
+    already registered result callback by default instead of chaining it.
+    """
+
+    def result_callback(self, replace: bool = True) -> t.Callable[[F], F]:
+        """Adds a result callback to the command. Unlike
+        :meth:`Group.result_callback`, an already registered result
+        callback is replaced by default. Pass ``replace=False`` to chain
+        the callbacks instead.
+
+        :param replace: if set to `False` an already existing result
+                        callback will be chained instead of removed.
+        """
+        return super().result_callback(replace=replace)
diff --git a/tests/test_replace_result_default.py b/tests/test_replace_result_default.py

+++ b/tests/test_replace_result_default.py
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+import click
+from click.replace_result_default import ReplaceResultDefault
+
+
+def _make_cli():
+    @click.group(cls=ReplaceResultDefault, invoke_without_command=True)
+    def cli():
+        return 1
+
+    return cli
+
+
+def test_replaces_by_default(runner):
+    cli = _make_cli()
+
+    @cli.result_callback()
+    def first(value):
+        return value + 10
+
+    @cli.result_callback()
+    def second(value):
+        click.echo(value + 100)
+
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, [])
+    assert result.output == "101\n"
+
+
+def test_explicit_replace_false_chains(runner):
+    cli = _make_cli()
+
+    @cli.result_callback()
+    def first(value):
+        return value + 10
+
+    @cli.result_callback(replace=False)
+    def second(value):
+        click.echo(value + 100)
+
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, [])
+    assert result.output == "111\n"
+
+
+def test_is_group_subclass():
+    assert issubclass(ReplaceResultDefault, click.Group)
